summary: Reference-only: activate with 1 minute of winding its unique hand key, taking the Utilize action each turn.
text: Reference-only: activate with 1 minute of winding its unique hand key, taking the Utilize action each turn. Operates for 10 days. It acts after you on your Initiative, follows your commands without an action, otherwise Dodges and avoids danger, and is destroyed at 0 HP. Touching it with its key as a Utilize action deactivates it (Unconscious). Medium Construct: AC 9, HP 5 (1d8+1), Speed 30 feet; Str 13, Dex 8, Con 13, Int 3, Wis 8, Cha 1. Immune to Poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned; passive Perception 9, understands Common but cannot speak; CR 0. When reduced to 0 HP, a Constitution save against DC 5 + damage taken leaves it at 1 HP, unless the damage was Lightning or a Critical Hit. See the linked source for its full servant stat block.
